scope: Bounded, source-text assertions from the CRAH and series-fan powered VAV sequences of operation on MI741 (source PDF page 68). The module records explicit control logic, safeties, alarms and setpoints without claiming that the rest of the 75-page source document has been sequence-audited.
coordinate_system: Displayed PDF page, points, top-left origin; 2448 x 1584.

visual_review.finding: MI741 was visually reviewed at 180 DPI. CRAH prose is in the central column and series-fan VAV prose is in the right column; assertions retain source spelling and do not infer unstated equipment applications.

assertions.expected: PRIMARY/STANDBY OPERATATION. CONTROLLER SHALL CONNECT TO DDC SYSTEM
IF ANY TEMPERATURE SENSOR VARIES BY 5°F OR MORE, AN ALARM SHALL BE GENERATED BY THE MASTER CRAH CONTROLLER
FIRE ALARM PANEL (FAP) SIGNAL THAT TAKES PRECEDENCE OVER ALL OTHER STARTER INPUTS
WITH THE H-O-A SWITCH IN HAND POSITION, THE SUPPLY FAN SHALL START AND RUN CONTINUOUSLY, SUBJECT TO SAFETIES
WITH THE H-O-A SWITCH IN AUTO POSITION, THE SUPPLY FAN SHALL RUN SUBJECT TO THE SUPPLY FAN START/STOP (SF-SS) COMMAND AND SAFETIES
COOLING COIL CONTROL LOOP SHALL BE DISABLED AND THE DUTY UNIT SUPPLY FAN SHALL RUN AT MINIMUM SPEED TO CIRCULATE AIR IN THE SPACE 24/7/365
WHEN ZN-T RISES ABOVE ZN-T-SP (WITH A 2 DEGREES F DEADBAND) THE LOCAL CRAH CONTROLLER SHALL ENABLE COOLING MODE
FAILURE OF ANY PROOF OR ACTIVATION OF ANY CRITICAL SAFETY SHALL RESULT IN ALL CONTROL LOOPS BEING DISABLED AND THE CRAH FAN BEING COMMANDED OFF UNTIL RESET
IN THE EVENT OF SMOKE DETECTION, THE CRAHS SHALL BE SHUTDOWN
DDC HARDWARE RESET OF ALL PROOFS AND SAFETIES SHALL BE VIA A LOCAL BINARY PUSH-BUTTON (RST-BUT) INPUT TO THE DDC HARDWARE, VIA A REMOTE COMMAND TO THE DDC HARDWARE
VALVES FOR THE FIRST STAGE OF COOLING. THE CONTROLLER SHALL MODULATE FAN SPEED AS THE SECOND STAGE OF COOLING
WHEN THIS LOOP IS DISABLED, THE CHW VALVE SHALL BE CLOSED
DUTY UNIT FAILURE SHALL BE DUE TO FAN FAILURE OR HIGH/LOW TEMPERATURE FOR 15 MINUTES OR LONGER. THE STANDBY UNIT SHALL BE ENERGIZED AND SHALL BECOME THE DUTY UNIT
THE DUTY UNIT SHALL BE ROTATED EVERY 40 HOURS
IRREGULAR SENSOR TEMPERATURE (CRAH-M1A/B ONLY). A TEMPERATURE SENSOR VARIES 5°F OR MORE FROM AVERAGE ZONE TEMPERATURE (ZN-T)
RANGE EQPT COOLING SETPOINT (RE-T-SP): 72°F
INSTALL DDC HARDWARE TO PERFORM THIS SEQUENCE OF OPERATION AND TO PROVIDE INPUTS AND OUTPUTS AS SPECIFIED AND SHOWN ON THE POINTS SCHEDULE
SERIES-FAN POWERED BOXES SHALL BE OPERABLE DURING WITH OCCUPIED PERIODS DETERMINED BY DDC SYSTEM SCHEDULER OR DURING UNOCCUPIED MODE WHEN COOLING OR HEATING IS REQUIRED
BOX SHALL MODULATE PRIMARY AIR DAMPER BETWEEN MINIMUM AND MAXIMUM TO MAINTAIN SPACE BELOW OCCUPIED COOLING SETPOINT
MODULATE BOX DAMPER TO MINIMUM POSITION AND MODULATE HHW VALVE TO MAINTAIN SPACE AT OCCUPIED HEATING SETPOINT
THE FAN SHALL BE DE-ENERGIZED IF THE SPACE TEMPERATURE IS WITHIN UNOCCUPIED HEATING AND UNOCCUPIED COOLING SETPOINTS
THE FAN SHALL BE ENERGIZED AND SHALL MAINTAIN A CONSTANT DISCHARGE AIRFLOW AND THE HHW VALVE SHALL BE MODULATED TO MAINTAIN SPACE AT UNOCCUPIED HEATING SETPOINT

THE ASSICOATED AHU SHALL BE ENERGIZED AND THE BOX FAN SHALL BE ENERGIZED TO MAINTAIN A CONSTANT DISCHARGE AIRFLOW. BOX SHALL THEN MODEULATE PRIMARY AIR DAMPER BETWEEN MINIMUM AND MAXIMUM TO MAINTAIN SPACE AT UNOCCUPIED COOLING SETPOINT
DDC HARDWARE RESET OF ALL PROOFS AND SAFETIES SHALL BE VIA A LOCAL BINARY PUSH-BUTTON (RST-BUT) INPUT TO THE DDC HARDWARE, VIA A REMOTE COMMAND TO THE DDC HARDWARE
FAN FAILURE (INDICATED BY STATUS MISMATCH)
OCCUPIED COOLING SETPOINT: 75°F (SPACE IS CONTINUOUSLY OCCUPIED)
UNOCCUPIED COOLING SETPOINT: 80°F (SPACE IS CONTINUOUSLY OCCUPIED)
